narrative.overview:
Class Recorder adopts DSH Go's Mist Glass design language to turn classroom lecture capture and on-device AI agent connectivity into a quiet, tactile pocket workbench. Instead of stacking opaque Material app bars, heavy bottom navigation slabs, or saturated neon timetable blocks, the interface floats translucent capsules and softly rimmed cards over a stationary full-bleed atmospheric gradient. Students opening the app seconds before a lecture begins see their auto-detected class, room, MCP server endpoint, and record trigger immediately, with every secondary control receding into mist-tinted neutral glass.

Both Light ("Morning Mist") and Dark ("Slate Night") themes derive their surfaces and neutral inks in perceptual OKLCH space from six low-saturation presets (Mist, Daiqing, Dusk, Turquoise, Amber, Graphite) plus Android 12+ Follow wallpaper. Roughly 70% of every viewport belongs to the gradient backdrop and translucent glass tiers, 25% to crisp ink or paper typography and 0.5dp hairlines, and 5% or less to active focal accents.
keyCharacteristics: Stationary full-bleed vertical gradient backdrop (DshBackdrop) with two soft corner radial glows shared across root pager tabs.
Floating Chrome-tier top SegmentedPill (Recorder · Schedule · Recordings) and bottom Composer dock with zero full-width bar slabs.
Four-tier Mist Glass hierarchy (Chrome, Sheet, Card, Pill) combining outer-only clipped shadows, 0.5dp inner hairlines, and top-45% vertical specular rims.
Contrast-guarded OKLCH palette derivation across six presets, live wallpaper color, and deterministic FNV-1a course identity hues.
Two-weight structural CJK/Latin typography (400 / 600) paired with 300 Light 48sp tabular clocks and recessed monospace CodeWell blocks.

rules.name: The Five-Percent Voice Rule
rules.body: Primary accent and Brick Rose never flood cards or toolbars; at rest, only the single primary action on screen (the 52dp circular record trigger on Recorder, the Now class mic button on Schedule, or the Play capsule on Playback) carries a solid color fill.

rules.name: The OKLCH Contrast Guard Rule
rules.body: Every preset and wallpaper-derived seed is binary-searched along OKLCH lightness (L) with chroma clamped (C <= 0.13, AppAccent.MAX_CHROMA) so primary vs onPrimary achieves >= 4.5:1 and primary vs surfaceContainerHighest achieves >= 3.0:1 in both Light and Dark modes.

rules.name: The Polarity-Aware Course Dot Rule
rules.body: Deterministic 8-slot FNV-1a course indicators (DshColors.courseDot) render at L = 0.79 on dark surfaces and L = 0.45 on light surfaces, inverting automatically on ink-selected filter chips so 4dp–9dp dots and timetable pips always maintain >= 3.5:1 non-text contrast.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Discipline Rule
rules.body: Structural UI text uses only 400 Normal and 600 SemiBold (plus 300 Light solely on large display numerals) because CJK system fonts synthesize muddy intermediate weights.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Every clock, duration, period range (13:25–14:15), weekday date numeral, count badge, and seek label enables OpenType tabular figures (tnum) and normalizes range separators to an en-dash (–).

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Never place tracked uppercase kicker or eyebrow labels above headings or cards; section headers use quiet sentence-case labelLarge (14sp) in textTertiary.

rules.name: The Exterior-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every GlassSurface shadow path is clipped with PathOperation.Difference (outerBounds - innerShape) before drawing so dark shadow blur never muddies the translucent glass interior.

rules.name: The Blur-Where-Needed Rule
rules.body: Chrome (18dp GraphicsLayer BlurEffect) and Sheet (24dp Android 12+ cross-window blur) refract underlying pixels when supported and automatically fall back to high-opacity fallbackFill on Android 10–11 or when system Reduce Motion (ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE == 0) is active; Card and Pill never blur (blurSigma = 0).

dos: Do wrap all secondary screens in AppPage and all modal interactions or destructive confirmations in AppSheet / DshConfirmSheet (28dp top corners, Sheet-tier glass).

Do keep GlassSurface child text legible across Light and Dark modes by relying on LocalContentColor (colorScheme.onSurface) and DshColors.textTertiary (>= 4.5:1 for text, >= 3.0:1 for waveform bars and course dots).
Do decode real audio envelopes (AudioWaveformDecoder) for ScrubWaveformCanvas and show an honest flat baseline when audio is silent or unavailable.
Do maintain >= 48dp × 48dp touch targets on every interactive control and verify layouts at 1.3x system font scale with feathered top and bottom BackdropVeils.
donts: Don't introduce opaque TopAppBar, NavigationBar, or Material AlertDialog slabs that break the full-bleed DshBackdrop and Mist Glass material system.
Don't place uppercase tracked eyebrows or kickers above headings, card titles, or hero blocks.

Don't parse raw neon timetable hex strings onto card surfaces or use low-contrast container pastels (identityBg) for small 4dp–9dp dots; map course names through DshColors.identityPair for large badges and DshColors.courseDot for dots and pips.
Don't apply real-time blur to scrolling Card or Pill list items, or run looping/spring animations when LocalReducedMotion.current is true.
